# sigma_whoami (Data Source)

Identity of the API client the provider is authenticated as. Useful to assert a configuration targets the intended organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sigma_whoami" "current" {}

# Fail the plan if the credentials point at the wrong org.
resource "terraform_data" "org_guard" {
  lifecycle {
    precondition {
      condition     = data.sigma_whoami.current.organization_id == var.expected_org_id
      error_message = "Sigma credentials belong to the wrong organization."
    }
  }
}

variable "expected_org_id" {
  type = string
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as `user_id`.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization ID the credentials belong to.
- `user_id` (String) Member ID of the authenticated principal.
